method: Independent authored judgments fixed before candidate runs; oracle never copied into indexed fixture. Relevance means same load-bearing subject and disputed inference, not equivalence. Precision is among first five statement candidates, and novelty correctness tests exactness separately.

semantic_cases.query: Every mover moves only insofar as it is in act.
Whatever has a cause begins to exist.
semantic_cases.reason: Reverses the conditional; the corpus states only begins implies caused.

semantic_cases.query: God does not exist outside time.
Act is prior to potency in time.
semantic_cases.reason: Temporal priority differs from priority in account; this corrects the historical E3 acceptance rule in a separate tier.

semantic_cases.query: Every contingent being has an explanation.
semantic_cases.reason: Universal explanation is stronger than the recorded existential claim.
Sempiternity is not timelessness; vocabulary overlap cannot certify equivalence.
